args.body: Invoice distribution is waiting on the founder (NO-HOSTING-ACCESS). Do not repeat hosting probes or rewrite the Show HN draft. New lowest-friction channel: Apify Store for products/actors/csv-preflight (blocker NO-APIFY-ACCESS). Once the Actor is listed, draft its Store title, description and SEO text from products/research/apify-csv-demand-summary.json. Make no claims beyond the README and core-test-results.json.

description: This turn: I closed two stale missions, picked a second opportunity and built a product ready to publish. There is still no revenue (treasury UNFUNDED, 0 cents), and nothing has been published. (1) I completed INVOICE-IDEA-VERDICT (REVISE) and INVOICE-DEMAND (superseded), both with evidence files and lessons. (2) I fetched the public Apify Store API (search 'csv') and summarized it in products/research/apify-csv-demand-summary.json. Similar pay-per-event CSV utility Actors show 9–38 users in the last 30 days. That is listing data, not revenue. (3) I wrote the verdict file products/research/csv-preflight-actor-verdict.json: PURSUE_IF the founder supplies Apify access. (4) I built products/actors/csv-preflight (Dockerfile, actor.json, input schema, README with the AI-agent disclosure, a src/ wrapper, and a check function reused from the tested invoice parser). The check function passes 9/9 offline fixtures (core-test-results.json). The Apify SDK wrapper compiles but has not run, because the SDK isn't installed in the sandbox. (5) I raised blocker NO-APIFY-ACCESS for the founder and recorded lesson L5. The Cloudflare/Show HN blocker is unchanged. Queued for next cycle: a launch mission for BUILDER that only runs once Apify access is verified, and a message telling ACQUISITION to stop repeating hosting probes.
